recipeInstructions.text: Rinse quinoa and combine with water in a small saucepan. Bring to a boil, then cover and simmer until the liquid is absorbed, 12-15 minutes. Fluff with a fork and spread on a plate to cool.
Whisk fresh parsley, red wine vinegar, olive oil, dried oregano, red pepper flakes, and a pinch each of salt and black pepper.
Just before serving, toss baby arugula and the cooled quinoa with the vinaigrette.
The quinoa and vinaigrette keep a day in the fridge, stored separately. Rewarm the quinoa slightly before tossing.
